notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: reviewed_by is null, no human reviewed or tested this package, and no hardware, ROS or Isaac Sim run was made. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card prefers an upstream-sim mock, but the environment needs Isaac Lab v2.1.1, Isaac Sim 4.5 and a GPU (docs/README.md:64-69, install.gpu), and this package never imports or runs the clone. The card's family and helper are unchanged (GymnasiumDriver). No live sim backend is declared; the fake is the only backend. It is an analytic F0 stand-in (fake.py), not a recording: no captured traffic or transcript is shipped in the clone. It models the 3-dimensional SE2 action [vx, vy, omega], the seeded reset, a 300-step/60 s truncation, the goal-dwell truncation (0.5 m for 4 s) and the software e-stop latch. It does not model rigid-body dynamics, contacts, the locomotion policy, the depth camera, the observation delay buffer, domain randomization or Isaac Sim, so the base_contact, large_pitch_angle and terrain_fall terminations are also not modelled, and it was not compared with an upstream run. Its action bounds [-1, 1] and observation sizes (10/12/10/1) are placeholders because the real action and observation spaces come from the external Isaac Lab ManagerBasedRLEnv and are not defined in the clone; only the 3-dimensional action layout and the four observation group names are sourced. The fake observation groups match those placeholder sizes and omit the upstream depth image (64x40 after downsampling from 192x120), height scan and joint terms. Goal, reset pose and reward are stand-ins. Expected Gymnasium-family warnings remain: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed of the next reset is set without a native call), five G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for action_space, observation_space, reset, step and close (the external ManagerBasedRLEnv base provides them outside the clone) and four G8.NO_UNIT for bridge-derived integer inputs (ticks, action.values and seed twice). There are no G4 warnings. Only catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used; no extension ids and no catalogue requests. No operator-required limit and no site overlay apply (simulated R0). The e-stop is the runtime's software latch; no independent physical stop is claimed. gate.digest is the digest line the last check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every run and is not part of the package.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Reviewed all card entries, action processing, termination counters, fake-only scope, stop/reset path and provenance against the pin. Fixed fake.py and test_driver.py so the goal counter continues after the first entry even after leaving the radius; driver.py now cites the counter and speed-bias behavior precisely and qualifies the stop to the analytic fake, disclosing the unsupported Isaac bootstrap/tensor route. Synchronized facts.md and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The fake gate, package tests and strict collector pass with contract_checked evidence. The override proposal retains NavigationEnv and removes the two configuration-only entry symbols. For the human reviewer: Only the analytic AoW-D fake is declared and supported; it omits the B2W-specific assets/configuration. The inherited generic gymnasium.make fallback lacks application bootstrap, cfg, registration and vectorized torch adaptation. The latch stops the fake only and provides no external Isaac Sim pause. Decide whether to apply the entry-symbol cleanup proposed here; task.json and the registry were left untouched.
